conversation_title: Three distinct insights in one chat
user_message: Insight A: most SaaS churn models underweight the second-renewal cliff. Insight B: gross-retention reporting can mask net retention trends if you only look at the trailing twelve months. Insight C: usage-based pricing makes expansion revenue much more cyclical than seat-based pricing. Are these related?
assistant_message: They are *adjacent* insights, not the same insight. Insight A is about renewal timing; Insight B is about reporting window selection; Insight C is about pricing-model mechanics. They cluster around 'SaaS revenue durability' but each is independently reusable. The right output is three separate notes (or three notes + a single high-level linking evergreen). Do NOT collapse them into one giant 'SaaS revenue durability' note — that destroys the mechanism-level resolution.
